Name: Professional Premium Food Color Gel Kit, Twelve Colors 2 Ounces by Chef Alan Tetreault
Natural: Professional Premium Food Color Gel Kit, Twelve Colors 2 Ounces by Chef Alan Tetreault. This kit contains one 2 ounce bottle of the following Premium Color Gels: Pink, Lemon Yellow, Leaf Green, Sky Blue, Royal Blue, Turquoise, Brown, Sunset Orange, Regal Purple, Fuchsia, Super Black, and Super Red. Chef Alan's Premium Gel Food Coloring delivers beautiful and brilliant color in icings and whipped toppings. The gel colors are freeze stable, with minimal fading and no bitter after taste. As with all colors, to obtain the deepest reds, blues, greens, blacks, or other colors, mix your colored icings 24 hours in advance, cover and store for later use - the colors will deepen overnight. Packaged in convenient 2 ounce squeeze bottles, Chef Alan's gel colors can be dispensed one drop at a time so you can achieve precise, easy to repeat colors. Made in the USA. FDA approved colors. Kosher Pareve.
